overview_description.description: Farminal is a dairy farm management technology solutions company with focus on delivering niche complementary systems for large and medium dairy farms, as well as affording sustainable solutions for small farms. The company relies on its core competitiveness with image analysis to be the first in the market that delivers cow care through automatic vision.
